hardware.reference: one Windows laptop with integrated graphics, the Ubuntu-26.04 WSL host and the Kali host; a 4 GB-RAM machine for M-11
hardware.budget_source: M-02 replaces every provisional number with a reading or a recorded waiver

tasks.title: Shard manifest spec v1 (shard.json + JSON Schema)
tasks.deliverable: docs/METTHEW/shard.schema.json + prose in the plan: id, version, genre, files, entrypoint, loader, golden_run {input, ticks, state_sha256, token}, hubs[], budget, licence, author_pubkey
tasks.acceptance: validates the three M-05 shards; rejects 5 named malformed fixtures (missing golden run, undeclared hub, oversize payload, entry outside shard, duplicate id) with the offending field named
tasks.risk: a schema that only fits one genre will be rewritten by M-05; keep the engine out of the schema

tasks.title: Low-end budget bench
tasks.deliverable: tools/metthew_bench.py + budget.json (load, tick cost, peak RSS, validator wall clock, play fps at 720p)
tasks.acceptance: three runs per scene, numbers reproducible within 10%; every provisional plan number replaced by a reading or a recorded waiver; the failing numbers are published, not rounded
tasks.risk: measuring on a fast host and calling it 'low-end' would invalidate every later gate; the box is named in the record

tasks.title: Validator tools/metthew_validate.py
tasks.deliverable: static liftability check (no reference escapes the shard), hub declaration check, payload budget, golden run, determinism re-run, JSON report, exit codes, --selftest
tasks.acceptance: pass/block on 3 fixtures in the tests; a shard with one external reference is blocked and the blocker is named with graph + ref count; a shard that fakes its state hash is blocked; exit 0 only when every gate passes
tasks.risk: an oracle that has never failed is not an oracle -- the negative controls ship in the same change (RULE 0B-C)

tasks.title: Minting CLI: metthew mint <name>
tasks.deliverable: scaffold manifest, golden run, self-test, placeholder scene; run the validator; print the exact next command
tasks.acceptance: mint -> validate -> play in <=10 minutes on the reference box with no toolchain beyond python3; the scaffolded shard is green before it is edited
tasks.risk: a scaffolder that hides the manifest teaches nothing; the manifest must be the first file a gamer reads

tasks.title: Three reference shards, three genres
tasks.deliverable: 2-player arena; single-player puzzle; doc+data-only rule set/roster pack; each <=24 files
tasks.acceptance: all three validate green on Windows/Ubuntu/Kali; arena and puzzle run at 720p/30 on the reference box; the doc-only shard loads with zero code
tasks.risk: three from one author still share that author's blind spots; M-10's play test is the counterweight

tasks.title: Deterministic play ledger and replay verifier
tasks.deliverable: fixed-step sim, input log, per-tick state hash chain, replay verifier, documented numeric policy
tasks.acceptance: same input log -> identical hash on all three hosts; a flipped input byte diverges at a named tick; 20-minute session replays in <=2 s
tasks.risk: float and iteration-order drift will look like cheating; a numeric policy (fixed-point or bounded float) is part of the task, not a follow-up

tasks.title: Exploit-as-content: antibody shard for game exploits
tasks.deliverable: signature/probe/instances/status shard in the shape of src/SHARDS/antibodies.py, with seeking -> neutralized -> immune tied to recorded seek evidence
tasks.acceptance: one real exploit demo cloned into a probe that finds it in 3 fixture shards and in none of 3 clean shards (positive and negative control); status cannot advance without the recorded seek
tasks.risk: an antibody that fires on healthy shards splits a circle faster than cheating does

tasks.title: Bundle exchange (USB / LAN / chat)
tasks.deliverable: one-file bundle (payload + manifest + hash), metthew add <bundle>, verify-then-play; the circle's shard list is a local file
tasks.acceptance: a tampered bundle is refused with the hash mismatch named; a bundle over budget is refused by the budget gate; installing requires no network
tasks.risk: file exchange does not scale past a circle; M-10 records that boundary rather than papering over it

tasks.title: Local reputation: signed result files
tasks.deliverable: signed result file (shard id, version, state hash, score, witnesses) that travels with the bundle
tasks.acceptance: forged score fails signature; a result whose shard version/hash does not match the installed shard is rejected; no global ranking is implied or stored
tasks.risk: signature files are not a reputation system; the plan says what they cannot do (Sybil, collusion) in the player-facing text

tasks.title: Circle protocol + 3-person play test
tasks.deliverable: written procedure: how a circle starts, mints, shares, contests, retires; plus the write-up of a real 3-person run with timings
tasks.acceptance: mint -> share -> play -> contest -> retire completed with no central service; every step names the command that performed it and how long it took
tasks.risk: a play test with the author present tests the author; one participant must be the non-author who runs the commands

tasks.title: Portability matrix
tasks.deliverable: matrix of validator + one reference shard across Windows 10/11 iGPU, Ubuntu-26.04, Kali, and one 4 GB-RAM host
tasks.acceptance: one row per host, pass/fail per gate, and the exact failing command for every fail; no host is reported green without a run
tasks.risk: green on the author's machine is the default outcome; the matrix exists to make that inadmissible

tasks.title: Project gates: unplayable ratchet + weekly cold run
tasks.deliverable: baseline of unplayable shards that may fall and never rise (the unresolved-ratchet pattern) plus a scheduled cold run
tasks.acceptance: ratchet fails on a newly unplayable shard and passes on a fix; --selftest runs with its negative control; a stale baseline is reported stale rather than trusted
tasks.risk: a ratchet nobody runs is a comment; the scheduled run is part of the acceptance, not a later convenience

contract_changes_pending.status: proposed, not accepted; M-01 should not freeze until each is decided either way

items.change: sandboxed loader (WASM or restricted VM: no clock, no RNG, no filesystem, no network)
items.because: R2 - a shard is currently arbitrary code from a friend's USB; measured: src/INTERPRETERS/* run raw subprocesses with only cwd+timeout

items.change: one-download player (browser/WASM target) as the distribution unit
items.because: R1 - install-python-first is where a non-author player stops

items.change: hubs as versioned shared libraries, declared and counted
items.because: R4 - banning external references forces every shard to duplicate its engine inside 24 files

items.change: competitive flag: determinism declared per shard, not required of all
items.because: R3 - the hash chain is a tax against ranked strangers, and a circle has none

items.change: content-addressed shard ids (id@hash) with host-version fallback
items.because: R6 - version skew currently reads to players as a broken game

deferred: visual identity or raised payload budget (R10, M-02)

known_limits: discovery is social: a circle works for five friends and fails for five thousand strangers
determinism across hosts needs a numeric policy or the replay verifier will disagree in ways that look like cheating
a cheat inside a shard's own golden run is invisible to the validator; only a peer re-run or an antibody shard catches it
budgets in the plan are commitments to measure, not results
